lines.speaker: FASSBENDER
lines.text: Brendan, I just got a question and I think Mark's gonna have some too. We didn't ask this before. Did he say anything about cutting her up or anything like that or did he put her body in there whole.......?

lines.speaker: FASSBENDER
lines.text: Brendan, you told us earlier that what you saw was the whole body right? OK. Could you indicate that the body appeared to be whole or however you want to put it in your words. And where it was located, you had said under certain items.

lines.speaker: WIEGERT
lines.text: Did he say where he got the knife from, Brendan? Or who's knife it was? Did he say where he got it from? No?

lines.speaker: WIEGERT
lines.text: When he was telling you about how he stabbed her, was he laughing, enjoying it, or how was he putting it to you.

lines.speaker: BRENDAN
lines.text: He was just staring at the ground.

lines.speaker: WIEGERT
lines.text: Did he say he was sorry or anything? He just stared at the ground. Is that what you said? Yes or no.

lines.speaker: FASSBENDER
lines.text: Another thing that you had talked to us about is where he put the vehicle in the pit and what he did to the vehicle. He talked about how he hid it. Could you add that? .....

lines.speaker: WIEGERT
lines.text: Did he tell you where he put her in the truck?
